items.title: Ahead of the Moment: Celebrating 125 Years of Limbach
items.summary: Meet our esteemed guests (1:20) on this very special season 5 finale; all three have played an integral role in rebranding Limbach to be who we are today. In this episode, we hear from Katie Massie, Director of Marketing; Matt Katz, EVP Mergers, Acquisitions, & Capital Markets; and Jay Sharp, Regional President of the Midwest and Northeast. We talk about the stories and values from 1901 to now (6:39) that have shaped how we serve customers. And importantly, we discuss how Limbach’s evolved identity (13:30) has an impact for our investors, customers, and current as well as new employees. So to understand the future of Limbach and your part in it (27:00), tune into this episode and explore the resilience, adaptability, and focus it takes to not just survive 125 years, but truly thrive.

items.title: Planning with Purpose: Capital Strategies That Stick
items.summary: Join us as we break down what goes into a master plan, why it’s important, and how to utilize the data from your facility to inform that plan. Limbach Facility Services team members, Jody Reilly, Vice President of Healthcare, David Carter, Director of Program Management, Kamlesh Shah, Principal Engineer, and Stephen Reiland, Senior Program Manager join forces to discuss the value of facility assessments (4:38), what master planning is and how it can prevent costly missteps (10:10), and how our team can become an extension of the Owner’s team (20:05). Whether you’re planning next year’s budget or reevaluating your long-term facility strategy, you’ll want to tune into this episode for some key insights to fix short term issues while planning for long term success!
